verdict.rationale: Together AI documents performance-oriented serving. Dedicated endpoints offer "better performance" and no hard rate limits, provisioned throughput units come with committed throughput and reliability targets, and replicas autoscale between set bounds. SSE streaming supports incremental token delivery, and one community user reports "good speed." Time-to-first-token is only implied, not documented. Missing for 10: published TTFT/latency figures or SLAs, tokens-per-second throughput benchmarks, independent hands-on latency measurements, and documented latency-specific optimizations such as speculative decoding.
